name.value: Indian Residential School History and Dialogue Centre

description.value: The Indian Residential School History and Dialogue Centre, located on the UBC Vancouver campus, is a museum and educational institution dedicated to preserving the history and legacy of Indian Residential Schools in Canada. It serves as a place of learning and reconciliation, housing archives and facilitating dialogue about this significant chapter in Canadian history. Situated on the scenic UBC campus, it is accessible by bike via the campus cycling network.
